name: ogawa929
description: A personal plugin marketplace for Claude Code, hosting a curated collection of reusable skills.

plugins.name: hello-world
plugins.description: A minimal example plugin with a single /hello-world:greet skill — useful as a template for building your own plugins.

plugins.name: impl-flow
plugins.description: Interviews you into a use-case document, breaks the feature down into commit-sized implementation plans, and executes them with subagents sized to each plan's complexity. Run /impl-flow:spec (design+plan) and /impl-flow:implement independently, or /impl-flow:all for the full pipeline in one go.

plugins.name: reduce-hallucinations
plugins.description: Adds a research/investigation skill that grounds Claude's answers in direct quotes and citations, and permits acknowledging uncertainty. Only activates for investigation-style tasks, so it stays out of the way during implementation.

plugins.name: robotic-persona
plugins.description: A "Robotic" output style that strips answers down to telegraphic output: one fact per line, no copula, no connectives, no evaluative or emotional words. Japanese output drops です・ます and unambiguous particles, but restores anything whose absence would permit two readings. Select it under /config -> Output style.

plugins.name: git-commit
plugins.description: An auto-triggered skill that applies a house commit convention: prefix-tagged subjects (feat/fix/docs/refactor/chore/revert), a 50-character noun-phrase summary with no trailing period, What in the subject and Why in the body, and revert-safe commit granularity. Follows the repository's existing commit language.

plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Audits the files that shape Claude's behaviour — SKILL.md files, slash commands, CLAUDE.md and .claude/rules, subagents, output styles and plugin manifests — against Anthropic's published authoring guidance. Run /harness-audit:audit [path]; it inventories the artifacts with a scanner, checks hard limits, discoverability, conciseness and cross-file conflicts, and ends with a ranked list of fix and deletion proposals to approve.

plugins.name: statusline-pack
plugins.description: A configurable Claude Code status line: model, directory, git branch, context usage bar, cost, session duration and more, in one to three lines. Run /statusline-pack:setup to install a preset into ~/.claude and wire up settings.json, hand-edit ~/.claude/statusline-pack.json to change the segments, and /statusline-pack:restore to put your previous status line back.

plugins.name: drawio-diagram
plugins.description: An auto-triggered skill for draw.io / diagrams.net files that enforces human-readable layout: no overlapping shapes, edges or labels, text that fits inside its shape, categories shown through both colour and position, and a canvas enlarged to fit the content instead of the content squeezed to fit the canvas. Ships a validator script that checks the generated XML, and per-notation rules for ER, sequence, state, network and class diagrams.
